"An Indian tourist, Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, went missing in Kuala Lumpur on 23 August after a sinkhole suddenly opened beneath her on the pavement, causing her to fall into an 8-metre-deep hole. Rescue efforts have been ongoing, led by Malaysia's fire and rescue department, utilizing various technologies such as tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground-penetrating radar. However, the search has been deemed 'too risky' to continue with divers, due to safety concerns for the rescue personnel.

The operation has involved high-pressure water jets and excavators to clear debris from the underground drainage system. Divers were sent in early on Thursday but were quickly pulled out due to the dangerous conditions before they could reach any obstacles.

Authorities have reported that a soil slip occurred in the same location last year, indicating potential ongoing issues with the stability of the area.

* The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali has been stalled due to safety concerns, with no trace of her found except for her slippers.

The rescue efforts have been hampered by the challenging and dangerous conditions of the sinkhole and the underground drainage system.

Is there anything else I can help with?"
